cases.expected: After the setup (pit P8 at 150000,-80000 and a pipe leaving it), CD from the open point 130000,-80000 to the pit centre 150000,-80000 with levels 18.300 / 18.100 prints 'Inserted flow arrow. Flow: Open end -> P8' once, makes exactly one new pipe object, and the pipe box sits at y -80112.5 like the pipe that leaves the pit. A twin that ends the pipe 2 m short of the pit (R02b_BROKEN) must not say 'Flow: Open end -> P8'.
cases.why_not_unit: The join is made by the live CD point landing against the real pit in the drawing.
not_automated: This case counts for 'a pipe ended on a pit joins it' only. The Pit Schedule row of P8 is read in R02 (the pipe that starts on the pit). The pipe's last vertex is not read: only CE's own command line and the pipe box row are checked.
cases.setup_note: shared setup SETUP-P8 run here for the first time at 10:52:43
